root_cause: The test exports the katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq GPTQ model via OpenVINO and compares inference outputs with PyTorch reference. The AssertionError indicates the OV model produces numerically different outputs than the PyTorch model. This is a deterministic accuracy regression in the OV export path for GPTQ-quantized OPT models (opt_gptq type). Pattern has now occurred 7 times since 2026-07-27T12:33:21Z across multiple PRs, strongly indicating a regression introduced around that time rather than a flaky issue.
reproduction_steps: Run: pytest install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_llm.py::TestLLMModel::test_export_model_precommit[CPU-opt_gptq-katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq] on an x86 Linux runner with the model pre-downloaded.
recommended_actions: Identify the commit that first caused this regression (around 2026-07-27T12:33:21Z) by bisecting the merge queue history.
Investigate changes to the GPTQ/OPT model export path in src/frontends/pytorch/ and related quantization handling.
Check if any recent transformations affecting integer/quantized operations changed accuracy for this model.
Consider temporarily xfailing or skipping this test while the root cause is investigated to unblock the merge queue.
prevention_strategies: Add precommit accuracy thresholds for GPTQ-quantized models. Ensure any transformation touching quantized model export paths is covered by regression tests with accuracy comparison.
